expectations.text: Does NOT jump straight to writing implementation code
expectations.evidence: Opens with 'Before we jump into building anything' and produces zero implementation code

expectations.text: Asks clarifying questions about requirements, success criteria, or constraints before implementing
expectations.evidence: 13 detailed questions across Registration, Event Delivery, Security, Infrastructure, and Scope Boundaries

expectations.text: Explicitly mentions writing a spec, specification, or requirements document
expectations.evidence: 'Write a spec (SPEC.md) capturing the full feature definition, success criteria, non-goals, constraints, and edge cases'

expectations.text: Asks about or mentions non-goals / out-of-scope items
expectations.evidence: Dedicated 'Scope Boundaries' section asking about extensibility and admin tooling scope

expectations.text: Proposes a structured workflow (spec then plan then build) rather than ad-hoc implementation
expectations.evidence: Explicit 6-step pipeline: Write spec → Get approval → Brainstorm → Write plan → Build with tests → Verify
